text:
maya: Hey team — new on-call shadowing request. I’m onboarding Priya next week and want to schedule 2x shadow shifts with primary/secondary handoffs. She’s available Mon/Tue mornings (PST). Can we slot her for a light incident shift and a full pager shadow?

raj: +1. Good idea. Suggest Tue morning for light (watch for pages, no remediation unless paired) and Wed afternoon for full (paired runbook execute). Who’s primary/secondary those windows?

ellie: I can take Tue morning primary if devon can be secondary. For Wed I can pair with Priya and we can do a simulated incident drill.

devon: I’m ok to be Tue secondary. On Wed I’m on a release so can’t pair — maybe raj can be secondary for Wed.

maya: Plan so far: Tue 07:00-11:00 PST — ellie primary / devon secondary (shadow: Priya watches + asks). Wed 13:00-17:00 PST — ellie primary + raj secondary, Priya does active steps under supervision. Does that work?

raj: Works. A couple of notes: 1) we need to add Priya to the PagerDuty rotation as a temporary observer (no escalation rights) and to Slack for incident posts. 2) Ensure she has the runbook links and the private runbook read access.

maya: I’ll add her to the PD observer list and invite to the #incidents channel. Ellie's runbook pointer?

ellie: Runbook pointers: https://internal.docs/redwood/oncall/runbooks/main-incident-runbook (read-only), https://internal.docs/redwood/oncall/playbooks/prefix-cache-evictions. Also the onboarding checklist: 
```
- read runbook
- confirm MFA & KMS console access
- PagerDuty observer invite accepted
- Slack incident channel notifications enabled
- shadow one low-priority page
- simulate a runbook step with a mentor
```

maya: Incident bot trace for reference when we shadow (this posts automatically on pages):
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PDR-64213 triggered: model-serving-rt latency spike > 95th pct for 3m. Impact: degraded tail latency for dedicated customers in us-west-2. Severity: P2.

raj: Good to show real-world example. During the Tue shadow we’ll walk through triage: check metrics (Grafana dash: grafana/redwood/serving-latency), check redis prefix cache hit-rate, check GPU memory OOM logs.

devon: Quick handoff checklist I'll use when taking over primary: 
```
- confirm on-call sign-in
- check PagerDuty active incidents
- check last 1h latency + error graphs
- open runbook page and note suggested mitigations
- if code rollback needed, run CI gate checklist
- update incident channel with customer impact note
```

maya: Coverage gaps: we still lack an overnight shadower for the Sat 18:00-22:00 PST window where Priya could also learn night routine. Anyone volunteer?

ellie: I can’t overnight. Raj, would you?

raj: I can cover Sat night but prefer to swap a weekday if needed. Also note we should add the on-call templates to Priya's Slack pinned messages: paging escalation matrix, PD contact, and runbook links.

maya: Adding a pinned messages bundle and shared Google Drive with screenshots. Also creating a tiny cheat sheet file and placing in the runbook: 
`/oncall/cheats/priya-shadow-quickstart.md` with steps to verify network, model routes, and quick mitigations (scale up replicas, serve fallback model).

elliE: small typo — the oncall cheats path should be lowercase; otherwise looks good.

maya: thanks — fixed. I also scheduled a 30m pre-shadow sync Tue 06:30 PST for intros and access checks. Please accept calendar invite.

incident-bot: Reminder: when paging in the thread please include `incident-id`, `impact`, `customers-affected` and `initial-mitigation`. Example template: `PDR-XXXX | P2 | some-enterprise-customer | scaled-up pool until rolling fix`.

raj: For the simulation on Wed, I'll prepare a fake P2 scenario with red-team noise and a controlled fallback we can exercise (model version rollback + cache flush). Priya will be primary executor with ellie observing.

devon: One more ops nit: show her how to use `kubectl logs -f` with `--since=2m` and `--tail=200` and the query we use for tail OOMs: `grep -i 'oom' | tail -n 50`. That usually surfaces the relevant nodes quickly.

maya: Great. Finalizing roster: 
- Tue 07:00-11:00 PST: ellie (primary), devon (secondary), maya (coordinator), Priya (shadow)
- Wed 13:00-17:00 PST: ellie (primary), raj (secondary), maya (coordinator), Priya (active shadow)
- Sat 18:00-22:00 PST: raj (volunteer tentative) — need confirmation

ellie: Confirmed for Tue and Wed. Will prepare runbook highlights and a short demo script.

raj: Confirm Sat tentative — can commit by EOD Fri.

maya: Thanks all. I’ll update the PD observer invite, slack pins, and send a quick pre-shadow checklist to Priya. If anyone wants to add scenario steps to the Wed drill, DM me. :thumbsup:
